forbidden_patterns.pattern: Invented Invoice <-> Payment edge without a PAYMENT_ALLOCATION provenance record
forbidden_patterns.rationale: The frozen projection is allowed only with its exact PAYMENT_ALLOCATION provenance; the allocation-node route is the fuller lifecycle representation.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Fuzzy ID, cross-type fallback, nearest neighbor, collision winner, or inferred relation
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Only persisted exact frozen edges may be followed.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traversal through department, cost_center, source_system, status, or any other non-node dimension
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Attributes cannot be promoted to bridge nodes or inferred edges in this phase.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Continue from APPROVAL_EVENT or AUDIT_EVENT reached after hop 0
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Events enrich local evidence but cannot route to unrelated neighborhoods; an exact event anchor may take one typed owner exit at hop 1.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Any graph edge without an exact current-type/relation/direction/next-type grammar row
forbidden_patterns.rationale: The typed grammar is a whitelist, never generic BFS.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Any fourth or later graph edge
forbidden_patterns.rationale: MAX_PATH_DEPTH is fixed at three for this proposal.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Any * -> EMPLOYEE -> * path, including actor/approver coercion
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Employee identity may be shared/system context and cannot route between transactions.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: GL traversal without exact source_transaction_id and frozen transaction_type target mapping
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Typed GL provenance must select exactly BANK_TRANSACTION, INVOICE, or PAYMENT.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Silently select one neighbor or treat M:N/N:1 as 1:1
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Enumerate exact neighbors deterministically; a future cap may stop expansion but cannot rewrite cardinality.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: PAYMENT <-> BANK_TRANSACTION
forbidden_patterns.rationale: The deterministic payment-bank relation is not frozen; amount/date/currency/account heuristics remain Tier B and disabled.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traverse when source, target, edge, or provenance-effective availability exceeds cutoff
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Every path participant must be cutoff eligible; edge effective availability is the latest participant availability.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traverse an edge without retainable source fields, target fields, edge ID, and provenance record
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Every path step must remain operationally reconstructible.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Continue from GL_ENTRY reached from BANK_TRANSACTION, INVOICE, or PAYMENT
forbidden_patterns.rationale: A reached GL entry is a terminal accounting consequence; only an exact GL_ENTRY anchor may exit to one typed source at hop 1.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Any candidate path in which a record_id repeats
forbidden_patterns.rationale: A record-ID-simple path prohibits A -> B -> A and longer cycles.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traversal based only on bank_account_id or gl_account
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Account values remain context/filter attributes and are not graph nodes or joins.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traversal based only on equal amount
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Equality of a non-node attribute does not establish an operational fact.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traversal based only on equal currency
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Equality of a non-node attribute does not establish an operational fact.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Traversal based only on equal date or a date window
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Date proximity does not establish an operational fact.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Embedding, text similarity, semantic neighbor, failure-class, or RCA-concept expansion
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Traversal correctness must arise from frozen operational relations, never label or semantic similarity.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: GL_JOURNAL node, journal_id bridge/group traversal, or AUDIT_EVENT -> GL_JOURNAL
forbidden_patterns.rationale: No canonical journal-header source record exists; gl_journal route labels resolve only to GL_ENTRY anchors.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Any * -> VENDOR -> * cross-transaction path
forbidden_patterns.rationale: Vendor is restricted identity/filter context and cannot route between transactions.

known_relation_gaps.description: No frozen deterministic PAYMENT <-> BANK_TRANSACTION relation exists.
known_relation_gaps.impact: KNOWN STRUCTURAL LIMITATION — BANK SETTLEMENT LINKAGE EXCLUDED

known_relation_gaps.description: No frozen BANK_STATEMENT membership/reconciliation relation to BANK_TRANSACTION exists.
known_relation_gaps.impact: BANK_STATEMENT has an explicit empty transition set in v1.1; no synthetic account/date linkage is permitted.

serialization_convention.json_separators: comma plus newline/indent; colon plus one space
serialization_convention.newline: LF with exactly one trailing newline
serialization_convention.other_array_order: explicit semantic parent order or explicitly documented stable key order
